title: Horizontal face formula at a single increasing target tuple
statement: For A,r,f,J, the union V, opens D, ordered differential, subset tuples and section transports of [def-sc-principal-open-cech-subset-insertion] and [def-sc-alternating-cech-total-complex], fix hle:D(S) <= D(S erase j) and the degree identities he:n+1-card(S erase j)=n+2-card(S) for j in S. Fix degree n, nonempty source subset S0, and x a section of J^(n+1-card(S0)) on D(S0). Put p=card(S0)-1 and q=n+1-card(S0). For every nonempty target subset S with card(S)=p+2, the ordered differential of the tuple singleton supported at the increasing enumeration of S0 with transported value x, evaluated at the increasing enumeration of S, is heterogeneously equal to section transport at S of the signed sum over j in S of restriction of the he-transported S erase j coordinate of Pi.single S0 x, with sign (-1)^card({i in S | i<j}). Empty erased subsets contribute zero. Unlike the parent, this statement has no total inclusion or subset insertion: it concerns one tuple coordinate only.

source.place: Tag 01FG, ordered differential and tuple product preceding Definition 20.23.2; Tags 08C0 (equation 20.40.0.1) and 08C1, alternating Cech totalization. Read online at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01FG and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/08C1.

proof.text: Expand alternatingCechDifferential at the target enumeration. The coefficient degree q agrees with n+2-card(S) by the cardinality assumption. Introduce explicit coefficient and open equality transports, reducing the heterogeneous equality to an equality in one module. Expand the additive maps through the sum.

Reindex positions k by S.orderIsoOfFin. The number of elements below the k-th entry is k, proved by filtering the image of the increasing enumeration and Fin.card_Iio. Deleting that position enumerates S erase j, proved by orderEmbOfFin_unique. Every deletion is nonempty since card(S)>=2. Convert the A-valued sign action to integer scalar multiplication.

If the erased subset differs from S0, its finite image proves the face tuple differs from the source tuple; both singleton coordinates are zero. Otherwise uniqueness of increasing enumeration identifies the face tuple. For the surviving term, naturality of overFunctorEquiv in opens proves section transport commutes with restriction. Naturality of the coefficient morphism moves the inverse degree cast past restriction, and composition of the two equality morphisms is the identity. Functoriality then combines the remaining open maps; their equality follows from thinness of opens. This proves each signed term and hence the coordinate formula. All these verifications are proved by private helpers in the module.

theorem principalSubsetHorizontalFaceCoordinate
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A)
    (J : CochainComplex (Spec (.of A)).Modules ℤ) :
    let V := principalSubsetUnion A r f
    let U : Fin r → V.toScheme.Opens := fun i ↦ V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (f i)
    let D := principalSubsetOpen A r f
    ∀ (hle : ∀ (S : Finset (Fin r)) (j : Fin r), D S ≤ D (S.erase j))
      (he : ∀ (S : Finset (Fin r)) (j : Fin r), j ∈ S → ∀ n : ℤ,
        n + 1 - ((S.erase j).card : ℤ) = n + 1 + 1 - (S.card : ℤ))
      (n : ℤ) (S₀ : {S : Finset (Fin r) // S.Nonempty})
      (x : (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj (J.X (n + 1 - (S₀.val.card : ℤ)))).obj.obj
        (op (D S₀.val))),
      let p := S₀.val.card - 1
      let q := n + 1 - (S₀.val.card : ℤ)
      let P := alternatingCechModulePresheaf.obj ((principalSubsetRestriction A r f J).X q)
      ∀ (S : {S : Finset (Fin r) // S.Nonempty}) (hcard : S.val.card = p + 2),
      HEq (((alternatingCechDifferential U P p).hom
          (Pi.single (principalSubsetTuple r S₀)
            ((principalSubsetSectionTransport A r f (J.X q) S₀).hom x)))
          (S.val.orderEmbOfFin hcard))
        ((principalSubsetSectionTransport A r f
          (J.X (n + 1 + 1 - (S.val.card : ℤ))) S).hom (
          ∑ j : S.val, if h : (S.val.erase j.val).Nonempty then
            (-1 : A) ^ ((S.val.filter (fun i ↦ i < j.val)).card) •
              (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj (J.X (n + 1 + 1 - (S.val.card : ℤ)))).obj.map
                (homOfLE (hle S.val j.val)).op
                ((modulesSpecToSheaf.map
                  (eqToHom (congrArg J.X (he S.val j.val j.property n)))).hom.app
                    (op (D (S.val.erase j.val)))
                    ((Pi.single S₀ x : principalSubsetCoordinates A r f J n)
                      ⟨S.val.erase j.val, h⟩))
          else 0))
